I’m Priyanka Gawade, a machine learning researcher and astrophysicist developing trustworthy methods for complex physical data—from strong gravitational lenses to transient light curves and images in the Rubin LSST era.

Current focusMultimodal machine learning for transient detection and classification

Profile

Physics-led questions.
Data-led answers.

My work connects physical modelling with modern machine learning. I design convolutional and Bayesian neural networks for parameter inference, quantify what models do not know, and validate them on simulated and real astronomical images and time-series data.
